name: Beyond the Gates
description: A powerful and prestigious family reigns over a posh gated community with juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered.

videos.title: Unveiling Fairmont Crest
videos.overview: The cast and creative minds behind "Beyond the Gates" share what makes the series a first-of-its-kind storytelling experience, both in front of and behind the camera.

videos.title: Creating the Cast
videos.overview: A look at the making of "Beyond the Gates" reveals the dedication and vision that brought the epic series to life; inside the casting process that built the show's powerhouse ensemble.

videos.title: Fashion and Flair
videos.overview: Exploring the artistry of the "Beyond the Gates" wardrobe, hair and makeup departments; the secrets behind the show's stunning hair and makeup, including a peek inside the wig cabinet housing more than 40 custom-designed wigs.

videos.title: A Day in the Life
videos.overview: A day in the life of the fast-paced world of "Beyond the Gates", where the cast tackles an intense filming schedule, plus the leading men and women of the series stop by for a few words.

videos.title: Sneak Peek and Guest Stars
videos.overview: An exclusive first look at the explosive premiere; the cast and creators talk about what's in store for Fairmont Crest; a look at the cast members' previous roles.

videos.title: Inside Fairmont Crest
videos.overview: Pulling back the curtains on “Beyond the Gates”with commentary from the actors as they relive storylines, including all of season one’s explosive affairs, shocking cons and family secrets.
